issues.description: Hardcoded conf=0.45 in model.predict() overrides CLASS_CONFIDENCE per-class thresholds defined in config
CLASS_ALLOWLIST and CLASS_REMAP are defined but not utilized in the visible inference pipeline
Code truncates at max_d parameter, leaving NMS post-processing and bounding box conversion incomplete
No explicit GPU/CPU device assignment or fallback mechanism for model initialization

summary: Inference pipeline uses hardcoded confidence thresholds ignoring per-class config, lacks model loading validation, and is truncated before post-processing.
